title: tc-evidence-coverage
description: What an answer could and couldn't see: each source category current, stale or missing, with a request for coverage.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

scope.description: A quiet line under the heading – what the coverage is of, e.g. "For this answer"

sources.description: The source categories, in the order to show them

summary.description: The summary line; unset, it's written from the sources ("Couldn't see …")

requestable.description: Offer Request coverage on stale and missing sources. Default true

inline.description: A quiet line under an answer instead of a card

open.description: Inline: whether the rows are folded out

locale.description: Locale for joining names into a sentence

age.description: How old the newest evidence is, as the app words it – "14 months", "3d". Shown with stale sources

detail.description: A quiet second line, e.g. "Last import 12 Aug" or "No feed connected"

request.description: The request's state, when the app owns it; unset, the element keeps its own

CoverageRequest.description: Where a coverage request stands: "pending" while the app sends it, "requested" once sent, "failed" if it couldn't
